_comment: Target schema for the dotBlue aggregate extracts loaded by
load_csv_into_iceberg.groovy. Types are declared here rather than
inferred from the CSV, so a column never silently changes type between
runs and a malformed file fails loudly instead of landing as VARCHAR.
Every table here is an AGGREGATE. No row identifies a person: there is no
user id, e-mail address, conversation title, message text or credential in
any column below, and group/period cells holding fewer than 10 distinct
users are suppressed upstream in the extract itself.
load_mode full_refresh: each run replaces the table contents, because
these are snapshot aggregates recomputed from the whole source, not an

dotblue_collection_profile.description: One row per MongoDB collection: document count and stored size.

dotblue_conv_by_hour.description: Conversations started per hour of day, Asia/Bangkok.

dotblue_conv_by_month.description: Conversations, distinct users and messages per calendar month, Asia/Bangkok.

dotblue_conv_by_dow.description: Conversations started per day of week, Asia/Bangkok.

dotblue_conv_by_endpoint.description: Conversations per LibreChat endpoint and preset.

dotblue_user_by_group.description: Users and conversations per e-mail-domain group. Groups below k=10 suppressed.

dotblue_conv_by_group_month.description: Conversations per group per month. Cells below k=10 distinct users suppressed.

dotblue_user_cohort.description: New user registrations per calendar month, Asia/Bangkok.

dotblue_user_mix.description: Long-format counts: auth provider, role, and conversation state.
